It holds no notion of a decision, a register or a disposition, so it provides no coverage of the decision-mapping concern and is not a duplicate of it. It is also inside a frozen engineering surface, so extending it is not an available route. Recording the boundary here is what keeps the duplicate-concept count at zero under a name that would otherwise invite the collision.
decisions.title: Architectural decision coverage and universe-to-code coverage are distinct concerns with distinct owners; neither is extended into the other

decisions.note: This is the single measured reason the aggregate gate is currently red, and it is independent of any decision recorded here: the located validator rejects a namespace the corpus legitimately uses.
